# Reproducible material: inventory (generated by analysis/p8_artifacts.py)

Every number and table in the paper is produced by a script in `analysis/` from files in `results/` (CLAUDE.md rule 1). The frozen protocols are `prereg.md` (hash in STATUS.md), `docs/planning/lore_qa/prereg_addendum.md` and `docs/planning/validation_v2/addendum.md`; every later change is in `DEVIATIONS.md` (D1–D19) and `DECISIONS.md`. Each run directory holds its config, a version manifest with sha256 hashes (checked at sync) and its outputs; `runs.jsonl` lists every run with its locked code commit.

## Files kept only on the run host

Files over about 100 MB stayed on the paused instance (`/home/results/...`) because the sync link was slow; each is listed with its sha256 in the run's `remote_only.json` and `manifest.json`. They are rebuildable from the run's config and locked commit (activations by re-running the extraction stage; generations by re-running the same greedy stage under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1`, which reproduced frozen rows exactly where checked). They are all activation files: inputs to stages whose outputs (probe selections and scores, H3c decoding AUROCs) are synced. Every analysis script that produces a paper number runs from files on the control host, except the H3c decoding runs (the H3c part of the Group 1 follow-ups and its canonical regrouping, `fu_08`), which ran on the run host next to the activations; their result files are synced.
